item.title: Deciphering the guilt and faith of the Iranian diaspora

item.title: Virologist Nathan Wolfe ’92 to end visiting appointment at Stanford amid Epstein report
item.description: The University confirmed that Wolfe’s appointment will not be renewed amid reporting by The Daily on the former professor’s relationship with Jeffrey Epstein. The post Virologist Nathan Wolfe ’92 to end visiting appointment at Stanford amid Epstein report appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Ebuka Okorie shatters decades-long freshman scoring record
item.description: Despite the loss on Saturday to Wake Forest, guard Ebuka Okorie ‘29 dropped 26 points and set a new freshman Men’s Basketball scoring record. The post Ebuka Okorie shatters decades-long freshman scoring record appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Stanford needs more rigorous general education requirements
item.description: Alexander Mescher writes about the need for a more stringent, rigorous Gen-Ed program at Stanford, arguing for a curriculum that teaches students to think critically as well as learn facts. The post Stanford needs more rigorous general education requirements appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
